# netbox_contact_group (Data Source)

Retrieves a single contact group from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contact_group" "example" {
  name = "Network team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the contact group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the contact group.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the contact group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the contact group.
